title: Nigeria Polytechnics
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for current Nigerian polytechnics in the NBTE 2025 directory boundary after excluding specialist institutes, colleges, transition records and other non-polytechnic entries.
methodology: SoftData reconciled the complete NBTE 25th Edition 2025 polytechnic-section roster before generating the dataset. Names and locations were normalized to current canonical forms; state_id values were mapped to the existing Nigerian states dataset. Specialist institutes, colleges, agriculture schools, technical institutes, converted institutions and unresolved non-polytechnic rows were excluded and documented in the reconciliation manifest. The public boundary contains only the five base fields and no website or logo enrichment.
source_hierarchy: official federal or state government publications
reputable secondary sources for discovery only

sources.title: 25th Edition 2025 Directory of Accredited Programmes
sources.purpose: Primary current roster boundary and ownership classification for Nigerian polytechnics.
categories_included: mixed NBTE-supervised institutions appearing under the polytechnic heading
missing_or_incomplete_fields: state_id is not a source field
some source names contain typographical errors
the heading includes specialist institutes, colleges and transition records

update_frequency: Review on each new NBTE directory or material regulatory roster update.
inclusion_rules: Current Nigerian institution classified as a polytechnic by the authoritative source hierarchy.
One record per current legal institution; campuses are not separate records unless independently recognized.
Every state_id resolves to ng-states and every record has country_code NG.
exclusion_rules: Universities, colleges of education, monotechnics, health or nursing colleges, technical colleges, specialist institutes, agriculture colleges, unapproved or closed institutions, and transition duplicates.
known_limitations: NBTE publishes some mixed or stale rows under the polytechnic heading; those source limitations are retained in the reconciliation manifest.
NBTE does not provide state_id as a normalized field, so state mapping is a SoftData compilation decision.
Institution approval and naming can change between directory editions.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. NBTE source publications retain their own rights. This pass adds only the static dataset foundation; it does not add websites, logos or API routes.
